name: Rigida
description: A supernatural race of ice-beings who took control of Almaaz in the Ice Age.

description_citations.text: "Terisiare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Ice Age the Rigida rule most of Almaaz and the Great Glacier buries the west; a new Sumifa is established in 1300 AR.
timeline.quote: In 1300 AR , a new Sumifa was established slightly west of the original site of old Sumifa.

citation.text: "Almaaz", section "The Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Drufalden kills her two sisters and imprisons her mother until death, becoming the last of the Rigida.
timeline.quote: after having killed her own two sisters and imprisoned her mother until her death
